{{Image}}
A '''multitool''' or '''multi-tool''' was a device that contained a variety of useful tools from drills to magnifying glasses. In some cases a multitool could be programmed to restrict its user from using a particular tool on a particular surface.

Though the tools contained within the multitool functioned much like their larger versions, they were not built for heavy work. The mechanical tools of the multitool could not be used for long periods of time, since doing so could overheat the multitool. Despite their drawbacks multitools could be found in the tool kits of both aspiring and professional mechanics alike.

A typical personal multitool came with 5-cm [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], a low power [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]], a small [[hydrogrip]], a toothpick and a small set of eating utensils. It was powered by a single [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]] that provided enough power for 50 hours.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Notable multitools==
*[[Kyle Katarn]] had given one to his father [[Morgan Katarn]] one as a gift, sometime before leaving for the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy]]; it had the dedication "To Dad, from Kyle" and his initials on the handle and he wore it on his belt pouch. Years later he gave it to [[Roskin]]'s toddler in order to keep him occupied on their trip to [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] (he had removed the power pak earlier).<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> It came back to him and he dropped it in a chamber near the [[Valley of the Jedi]]. It was found years later by his son who followed his trail.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
